ideas.pitch: A real-time voice and text tactical assistant for BGMI squads that analyzes map coordinates and gives live callouts during tournament matches.
ideas.title: BattleZone Coach AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the real-time interaction patterns from winning entries like loremaster to solve the exact tactical communication challenges in 4-player BGMI squads.

ideas.pitch: An experimental reinforcement learning bot trained on Battle Royale match trajectories to simulate enemy movement patterns for pre-tournament practice.
ideas.title: BGMI Autonomous Squad Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by adapting game AI simulation concepts similar to the OpenAI Open Model Hackathon winner, bota.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast web companion for tracking live elimination scores, cumulative map rankings, and tournament leaderboards across both rounds.
ideas.title: BattleZone Match Stats Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact administrative scoring headache of the two-round cumulative points format, ensuring an error-free live display for tournament organizers.

ideas.pitch: A 2D top-down mini-game enabling BGMI teams to practice parachute drop timings and vehicle rotations on replica Erangel and Miramar layouts.
ideas.title: Tactical Drop Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on gamified strategy rehearsal, utilizing a working mini-game approach that consistently wins gaming-focused hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An analytics overlay that parses post-match screenshots and replay data to generate team movement and engagement heatmaps.
ideas.title: SquadSynergy Heatmap
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides concrete performance metrics that competitive BGMI teams desperately need for post-match debriefs, ensuring high utility for players.
